messages:
ana: FYI after the keystore RBAC change this morning we got a spike in SAST findings across infra and terraform. ~118 new hits, many look like carrier-encapsulated tokens not plaintext.
chris: Can you paste one sanitized sample?
ana: sample from scanner (sanitized):
```
FILE: infra/terraform/vars.tf:23
FINDING: possible-aws-key
MATCH: AKIAXXXXXXXXXXXXXX
CONTEXT: value = 'sealed:carrier:v1:AKIAXXXXXXXXXXXXXX'
```
scanner-bot: scan id=220334 uploaded. report: https://scans.internal/220334 (redacted). Reaction :robot_face:.
maria: This is the sealed carrier format the keystore team rolled out. Detector regex is matching the AKIA prefix inside the carrier. Short-term: collect hit-sample + manifests, query KMS/CloudTrail for Decrypt events in the CI window, and open a scoped suppression while we patch.
ops: I can run CloudTrail for principal=svc-ci-builder@redwood.internal for window 2026-03-28T13:05Z-13:20Z. Will attach audit excerpt.
chris: For suppression, scope to infra/** and ruleset=current, TTL=72h. Add evidence bundle and approver.
maria: Long-term fix: update regex to ignore matches inside sealed carriers, and add detector logic to mark matches inside 'sealed:' as low-confidence. Proposed regex: `(?<!sealed:\w*:)\bAKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}\b`. Also add unit tests covering sealed:v1/v2 and real corpus.
nana: I like the low-confidence idea so analysts don't escalate immediately. Also add runbook blurb: "If SAST spike follows keystore RBAC changes, check sealed-carrier encodings and KMS decrypt audit before suppression."
scanner-bot: suppression PR template created: author=@chris, justification="sealed carrier encoding causing FP after keystore RBAC change", expires=72h, evidence_url=https://tickets.internal/SEC-1509/evidence.tar.gz.
ops: CloudTrail query result: no Decrypt events for svc-ci-builder during the window. Uploading audit snippet to SEC-1509.
chris: Opening suppression PR now: https://git.internal/scanner-configs/pulls/601. Added evidence and audit link. Approver requested: @maria.
maria: Reviewing evidence. Found two real plaintext creds in a legacy script (outside carriers). Filing rotation ticket and tagging app owner. Those are separate and high-priority.
nana: After local regex patch and unit tests, noisy hits dropped 118 -> 6. Manual review shows 4 true positives (including the legacy script) and 2 carrier-encoded false positives. Good reduction.
chris: Approving suppression after reviewing audit and evidence. Approve now.
maria: Merged suppression. Pushed detector patch branch scanner-configs:patch/ignore-sealed-carriers with unit tests. CI run looks good.
ops: Once ruleset candidate promotes to prod, revoke suppression and re-run nightly scan to validate.
nana: Added runbook one-liner to docs/playbooks/sdlc-scans.md and linked SEC-1509.
maria: Also filing a small UX ticket to surface keystore RBAC changes alongside scan-volume spikes in the console to help oncall correlate faster. https://git.internal/console/issue/1252
chris: Thanks team. Closing thread once ruleset merges and rotation ticket for legacy creds is resolved. :white_check_mark:
